verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents physical storage windows (30 days for letters, 10 days for packages) and includes secure shredding. Per-item disposal is shown by on-demand shredding of individual pieces (via the MCP server) and forwarding of physical items. There is no evidence of shred confirmation or certificates, and per-item disposal options in the main app are only lightly described. Missing for 10: documented shred confirmation or certificate, a detailed per-item disposal menu in first-party app docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I control what happens to the physical mail — documented storage windows, on-request shredding with confirmation, and per-item disposal choices

citations.quote: Physical mail is stored for up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages
